content.value_statement: Turkish messages need correct tone, grammar, and natural wording. This skill helps Claude, Codex, and Claude Code draft, revise, and adapt Turkish text.
actual_capabilities: Adjusts Turkish text for formal, business, academic, blog, and social media contexts.
Chooses sen or siz based on audience and formality.
Checks common Turkish spelling, grammar, punctuation, and de/da or ki usage.
Rewrites borrowed business terms with common Turkish alternatives.
Provides email templates for formal requests and business offers.
Uses an extended guide for capitalization, compound words, tenses, paragraphs, and connectors.
limitations: It offers language guidance, not certified legal, academic, or official institution review.
It does not verify facts, citations, or external style rules unless you provide them.
It focuses on Turkish and may not preserve nuance in mixed-language drafts.
It cannot guarantee full compliance with every TDK or institutional rule.

use_cases.title: Polish Customer Messages
use_cases.description: Turn direct or rough drafts into respectful Turkish replies with correct formality.

use_cases.title: Prepare Turkish Content
use_cases.description: Draft blog posts, social updates, and short announcements in natural Turkish.

use_cases.title: Improve Academic Style
use_cases.description: Revise paragraphs for neutral tone, passive voice, and clearer structure.

prompt_templates.title: Correct a Short Text
prompt_templates.prompt: Lütfen bu Türkçe metni yazım, noktalama ve doğal ifade açısından düzelt: [metin]

prompt_templates.title: Change Formality
prompt_templates.prompt: Bu metni [resmi/iş/gayriresmi] tona çevir. Sen/siz kullanımını hedef kitleye göre ayarla: [metin]

prompt_templates.title: Draft an Email
prompt_templates.prompt: Şu amaçla Türkçe bir e-posta taslağı hazırla: [amaç]. Alıcı: [alıcı]. Ton: [ton]. Beklenen sonraki adım: [istek]

prompt_templates.title: Revise With Constraints
prompt_templates.prompt: Bu metni kurumsal Türkçe için yeniden yaz. Yabancı kelimeleri azalt, cümleleri kısalt, tutarlı siz dili kullan ve değişiklikleri özetle: [metin]

output_examples.output: Toplantı hakkında geri bildirim alabilir miyim?
Raporu yarın gönderebilir misiniz? Teşekkür ederim.

output_examples.input: Bir kuruma bilgi talebi e-postası yazmam gerekiyor.
output_examples.output: Sayın Yetkili, konu hakkında bilgi verebilirseniz memnun olurum. İlginiz için teşekkür eder, iyi çalışmalar dilerim.

best_practices: Provide the audience, purpose, and desired formality before asking for a rewrite.
Share any required institutional style rules or terminology.
Review names, dates, facts, and legal wording before sending final text.
anti_patterns: Do not ask for one generic correction when you need a specific tone.
Do not mix sen and siz unless the audience change is intentional.
Do not use generated official letters without checking required format rules.

faq.question: Can it write formal Turkish emails?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes formal request and business proposal email patterns.

faq.question: Does it support informal Turkish?
faq.answer: Yes. It can use a simpler tone for friends, family, blogs, or social media.

faq.question: Can it fix de, da, and ki errors?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill highlights common Turkish spelling and grammar checks.

faq.question: Is it a certified proofreader?
faq.answer: No. It is a writing assistant and should not replace expert review.

faq.question: Can it help with academic Turkish?
faq.answer: Yes. It gives guidance on passive voice, paragraph structure, and neutral tone.

faq.question: Does it work with Claude Code and Codex?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill is marked for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
